Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to verify the accuracy of the management team members' joining years by relying solely on a single, generic web search query ("FuboTV management team joining year") that returned incomplete or inaccurate data. Specifically, the agent incorrectly identified "John Janedis" as a current management team member who joined in March 2020, whereas the ground truth indicates that John Janedis joined FuboTV in 2013 (prior to the IPO). This error stems from a lack of rigorous cross-verification of individual executive biographies and a failure to distinguish between co-founders/early employees and later hires, leading to an incorrect conclusion that two members joined in the IPO year.
